title: Determination 2014/033: proposed repair of fibre-cement overlay cladding on an earthquake-damaged house, Christchurch
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE determination under the Building Act 2004); comparative test only, not Alberta; NZ code references retained as written
code_edition: Building Code (Schedule 1, Building Regulations 1992), as cited

facts.text: Owners M and H Carey (applicants); the Christchurch City Council is copied as the authority, and the Earthquake Commission (EQC) is identified as a person with an interest.
The question is whether the proposed building work to repair the fibre-cement overlay cladding of an earthquake-damaged house at 9 Boys Place will comply with the Building Code.

The detached house was built in 1955 and extended about 1961; the applicants found two earlier forms of attempted repair when they bought it in 2007; internal alterations and insulation were added in 2009 and an unreinforced masonry chimney was demolished.
The house is single-storey light timber framing on concrete piled and perimeter foundations, on a flat, low-lying site.
